name: Bank
concept: The savings bank of Saint-Philippe, 1989: the two-storey vanilla Office_E_01 beside the town hall, fitted whole. A public banking hall with glazed teller counters and the bank-account teller, a deposit-slip desk, a queue rope and a wall clock; a manager's office; and the strongroom with its round door, drill and cash-bag robbery flow, the bell box on the front wall. The vanilla desks and bunk beds are cleared out of the rooms the bank uses; everything added is a static base-game prop.

rooms.role: public banking hall: three glazed teller counters across the room, two tellers (LF_Npc_Teller_2, the account teller with the ATM action), deposit-slip desk, queue rope, bench, wall clock, rates board
manager's office: desk, chairs, safe, shelves, carpet

strongroom on the east wall (LF_BankVault: round door, drill and charge, cash bag, hood roof); built onto the wall as the playtest town's bank vault is, since no back room of Office_E_01 is 3.4 m clear
staff floor: vanilla offices kept, beds and bath removed

interactables: teller counters (LF_ATMAction on the teller NPC)
stage: The kit is pack content, so the core GridWorld layer cannot name it (validate-addon-boundary): node tools/buildings/bank/stage.mjs writes an uncommitted Grid_zz_bankstage.layer (the kit, two tellers and the rob kit chest) at 300,300; look it with `tools\cli look 300,300 --world Worlds/GridWorld/GridWorld.ent`. Remove it (stage.mjs --remove) before a commit.
